workflow_cases.workflow:
name: bad
on: push
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

name: unsafe
on:
  pull_request_target:
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: npm test

name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@0123456789012345678901234567890123456789
      - run: npm test
